name: MessagingMapper
summary: Holds the conversion between domain objects and messages in a class of its own, so that neither the domain nor the messaging layer knows the other exists.

roles.name: MessagingMapper
roles.summary: The class that reads domain objects into a message and builds or updates them from one. It knows both sides and neither side knows it — the layers do not even know it exists, which is what keeps a message format from leaking references and inheritance the receiving application may not have.
